note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded ridge inland from Taylorsville Lake, near Mount Eden; the sites are set back from the water with no lake access from camp. Ten pull-through equestrian sites for horse campers beside the 24-mile hiking, biking and horse trail system; two playgrounds; marina and boat ramps in the park. --Claude
summary: Kept. $35-50 confirmed (W/E $35 weekday/$40 weekend; full hookup $45/$50), 44 RV sites with 50/30A + water, sewer at 1-10; showers, laundry, dump; season 03-15..11-15 (2027 RA schedule). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin move ~360 m, phone and website fixes.
